_comment: Tier-2 for dune::stokes#0, dune::mixed_methods#2 and dune::mixed_methods#4 — one fixture because all three are properties of the same two composite spaces and no weak form is built, so nothing JIT-compiles (wall time 8 s, 2026-08-06, dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Measured: hasattr(dune.fem.space,'product_space') is False and importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError, while product() and composite() over (lagrange(order=2,dimRange=2), lagrange(order=1)) both give dimRange 3 and size 187 — the same object for the same arguments. ufl.TrialFunctions(W) returns a 1-TUPLE whose single entry has shape (3,); the 1-tuple UNPACKS without error, which is why the mistake is silent, and the dolfinx two-name idiom fails with ValueError 'not enough values to unpack (expected 2, got 1)' — a message about counts, not about spaces. The documented workaround was executed: TrialFunction(W) sliced as as_vector([t[0], t[1]]) / t[2] gives shapes (2,) and (). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 replaces TrialFunctions(W) with the per-leg split a caller expects, i.e. a TrialFunctions that really does split a composite space. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'trialfunctions_len=1', 'trialfunctions_shapes=[(3,)]', 'one_tuple_unpacks_without_error=(3,)', 'two_name_unpack_rejected=ValueError', 'not enough values to unpack', 'dune_composite_space_unpacking_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
